# Remote & Hybrid Work Policy

Alderbrook Systems operates on a hybrid model: employees within 50 miles of an office are
expected in-office Tuesday/Wednesday/Thursday; Monday and Friday are remote-optional.

Fully remote roles are approved on a role-by-role basis by the hiring manager and HR Business
Partner. Employees working remotely must maintain a reliable internet connection (min 25 Mbps)
and be reachable during core hours (10am-4pm in their local timezone).

An equipment stipend of $500 is provided once for home office setup.
